definition.question: How intense is Russia-linked hybrid pressure on NATO societies and infrastructure short of direct force?
definition.low_end: Minimal attributable sabotage, cyber disruption, GPS jamming, or disinformation with no significant damage or disruption.
definition.high_end: Sustained, coordinated sabotage, cyberattacks and infrastructure disruption causing casualties, major economic paralysis or loss of critical services across NATO states.

readings.rationale: No graded claims provided to assess. Unassessed - research needed on sabotage, arson, cable/pipeline damage, cyberattacks, GPS jamming and information operations. Would be higher with multiple attributed incidents causing damage/disruption; lower with evidence of isolated or unattributed low-impact activity.

First assessed reading; prior unassessed. Evidence establishes sustained, coordinated, multi-domain pressure well above minimal: confirmed GRU Unit 29155-led campaign since Feb 2022 using gig-economy proxies after 2022 expulsions; sabotage attacks nearly tripled 2023 (12) to 2024 (34), ~200 incidents tracked by AP, >50 by IISS; specific confirmed attributions include Warsaw-Lublin C4/rail…
